DIWALI SUNSET SOIREE x THE CHAI RAVE
Forget the standard Diwali Party. The prompt is clear: serve major high-fashion, celebrate South Asian excellence, and stay on the floor until the lights come on.
We’re fusing underground rave culture with South Asian identity as DJ Dharak and DJ Rishik take over the decks. No tropes, no basic vibes—just a collective of stars, founders, creators and you bringing heavy bass, raw energy, and pure economic power to the heart of NYC.

✨THE VIBE
Couture Energy: Festive High-Fashion. Serve a look.
The Sonics: Indo-House, BollyTech, and ethereal live vocals.
The Space: An opulent world paired with rooftop views designed for your feed.

📅 THE ESSENTIALS
When: Saturday, Nov 7th | Red Carpet @ 4 PM
Where: To be announced to ticket holders the day of the event
The Door: Strictly 21+. Bring main character energy, leave the ego at home.

Space is strictly limited @ www.TheChaiRave.com
